description: Core Markdown constructs where the two render paths historically disagreed: HTML5 void elements and raw HTML sanitisation

cases.name: image
cases.description: Images are void elements in HTML5 style, with alt right after src

cases.name: image-empty-alt
cases.description: An empty alt text is still emitted, as alt is required markup

cases.name: image-title
cases.description: A link title becomes a title attribute, after alt

cases.name: thematic-break
cases.description: Thematic breaks render as an HTML5 void <hr>

cases.name: thematic-break-dashes
cases.description: A --- rule is only a thematic break once content precedes it; a leading --- opens a frontmatter block

cases.name: hard-break
cases.description: Two trailing spaces produce an HTML5 void

cases.name: html-block-omitted
cases.description: Raw HTML blocks from the source are replaced by a placeholder comment; the AST carries the placeholder, not the source markup

cases.name: inline-html-omitted
cases.description: Inline raw HTML is replaced by the same placeholder, without a trailing newline
cases.html: x y z
